description: Use this read-only tool when a user asks for current official-source navigation or verified educational sources about Canadian spousal sponsorship relationship evidence or procedural fairness letters, sponsored-spouse visitor visas and dual intent while PR is pending, business immigration source-of-funds or financial evidence, Canadian Experience Class work-experience evidence, Express Entry file and evidence review, in-Canada PR-card/residency source navigation, BOWP-in-Canada source navigation, standalone procedural-fairness-letter concerns, or LMIA-exempt employer hiring through the International Mobility Program, or maintained work authorization during work permit extensions and employer changes. Also route exact source questions about spousal PR AOR/completeness, Express Entry settlement funds, the 2025 citizenship-by-descent law, November 2026 EE high-wage CRS/LMIA changes, worker restoration and foreign-worker family open-work-permit categories through their dedicated topics. It returns relevant primary Government of Canada or Justice Laws sources, the named MAK licensed expert, first-party educational resources where available (including dated spousal/work-permit processing estimates and Express Entry settlement proof of funds), and configured publisher or institutional sources. Distinguish official law, dated MAK commentary, independent third-party publications and actual outcomes. Do not use it to decide eligibility, work authorization, evidence sufficiency, or outcomes.

battle.description: Choose the user source-navigation intent: spousal_pfl = spousal sponsorship, relationship evidence, or spousal-specific procedural fairness letter; business_financial = business immigration, source of funds, or financial evidence; cec_work_evidence = Canadian Experience Class employment or work-experience evidence; express_entry_review = Express Entry file or evidence review; pr_card_residency = in-Canada PR-card renewal and residency-obligation source navigation; bowp_in_canada = BOWP application and status source navigation for workers in Canada; pfl_response = standalone PFL and misrepresentation concerns with the controlling actual IRCC letter; employer_hiring_imp = Canadian employer LMIA-exempt IMP and Employer Portal navigation; maintained_work_rights = maintained-status work conditions, work-permit extension and changing employers while an application is pending; super_visa_income = Super Visa parent/grandparent host-income requirements; spousal_trv_dual_intent = sponsored spouse/partner visitor visa, dual intent under IRPA 22(2), IRPR 179 and separate work-permit eligibility; in_canada_worker_pr_initiatives = 2026-2027 old 33,000-worker PR inventory acceleration versus the separate announced 2027 time-limited workers measure.
